# Copilot instructions

Generated by @caisson-sh/agent-dev from one typed Caisson schema (GitHub Copilot harness; ADR-0264).

## Agents

### code-reviewer

Reviews a diff for correctness and the security floor.

- Capabilities: code_review, security_audit
- Tools: read, grep, bash
- When to invoke: A bounded diff needs an idiom + security pass before SHIP.

## Skills

### guided-execution

Execute a written plan task-by-task with review checkpoints.

1. dispatch a fresh subagent per task
2. review the diff
3. unblock the next task

## Rules

### no-any-in-prod (error)

Production code may not use `any` or silence a real type error.
